observation: Linear baseline already gets 0.813 val AUC with no train-val gap (0.812 vs 0.813), so most of the signal is close to additive. Recall of 0.17 at the 0.5 cutoff comes from only 15% of rows being positive, not from bad ranking.
Fully grown trees memorised the training set (train AUC 0.9999 vs val 0.783), the biggest variance gap of all runs. Default depth hurts here, which is why E3 needed tuning.

Depth 14, min leaf 20 and balanced_subsample weights cut the gap to 0.031 and lifted val AUC to 0.818. Recall jumped to 0.76 mostly because of the class weights (precision fell to 0.33), not because ranking got better.
Shallow boosted trees (depth 3, lr 0.03, l2 10, min leaf 100) gave the best traditional AUC, 0.820, with a gap of only 0.002 and 9 s training. Heavy regularisation works because the signal is simple.
Trained on only 15k rows for cost, AUC 0.801. The drop is a mix of less data and a non-linear kernel adding nothing over the linear model. Balanced weights give recall 0.77 at precision 0.32.
Plain 64-32 network gets 0.8175, about the same as boosting, so the net does not need to be big. Small gap (0.0075) from 20 epochs with no regularisation or early stopping.

Batch norm, dropout, L2 and early stopping gave the best val AUC overall (0.820) and closed the gap to 0.001, but the gain over E6 is only 0.003. Recall at 0.5 is lowest (0.12) because the model is calibrated to the 15% base rate.
Residual block, lower learning rate and LR schedule gave 0.8198, same as E7 within noise. Extra complexity cost more time (41 s) with no real gain at this depth.
Same model as E8 plus class weights (5.5x): AUC unchanged (0.8195) but recall went from 0.16 to 0.81 and precision from 0.59 to 0.31. Weighting moves the operating point, not the ranking.
Six engineered features did not help boosting (0.8194 vs 0.8198 for E4). They are sums, products and bins of columns the trees can already combine.
Same result for the network (0.8194 vs 0.8198 for E8). The net learns these interactions by itself, so the engineered features are redundant here.
